title: Verify Before You Generate: Sketch-Guided Efficient Motion-Planning for Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2511.17450v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent video generation approaches increasingly rely on planning intermediate control signals like object trajectories to improve temporal coherence and motion fidelity. However, these methods mostly employ single-shot plans that are typically limited to simple motion instructions, leading to suboptimal motion quality, or iterative refinement which requires multiple calls to the video generator and incurs high computational cost. To address this trade-off, we propose SketchVerify, a training-free framework whose key insight is to verify motion plans using lightweight video sketches before invoking the expensive video generator. This lightweight planning space enables efficient comparison of multiple candidate trajectories and bounded iterative refinement before a single final video-generation pass. Given a prompt and a reference image, SketchVerify samples multiple candidate trajectories and renders each as a lightweight video

translated_title: 先验证再生成：面向视频生成的草图引导高效运动规划
translated_abstract: 近期的视频生成方法越来越依赖规划中间控制信号（如物体轨迹）来提升时间一致性和运动保真度。然而，这些方法大多采用单次规划，通常局限于简单的运动指令，导致运动质量欠佳；或者采用迭代精化，需要多次调用视频生成器并产生高昂的计算成本。为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了 SketchVerify，这是一个无需训练的框架，其核心洞察是在调用昂贵的视频生成器之前，先使用轻量级视频草图来验证运动规划。这一轻量级规划空间使得能够在最终的单次视频生成之前，高效比较多条候选轨迹并进行有界的迭代精化。给定提示词和参考图像，SketchVerify 采样多条候选轨迹，并将每条轨迹渲染为轻量级视频……
tldr: 提出了 SketchVerify，一个无需训练的框架，在调用昂贵的视频生成器之前先通过轻量级视频草图验证运动规划，从而高效比较并迭代精化多条候选轨迹，以低成本获得高质量运动。
en_tdlr: SketchVerify is a training-free framework that verifies motion plans using lightweight video sketches before invoking the expensive video generator, enabling efficient comparison and bounded iterative refinement of candidate trajectories in a single final generation pass.
